Recover some [[Stolen Supply Shipment|stolen supplies]] to [[Ghost of Althea|Althea's]] refugee encampment in the [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Enter the [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]].
*Deliver the [[Supply Shipment|supplies]] to [[Ghost of Althea]].
*Find a way to the next floor.
*Track down [[Duke Willgrove]] and recover the [[Stolen Supply Shipment|stolen goods]].
*Return the stolen supplies to Ghost of Althea.
*Speak with Ghost of Althea.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
''Players familiar with the [[Forsaken Tunnels]] will find this quest to proceed in a similar way, with the Duke at the same location as [[Maz Scourgeheart]], without a boss key or lock.''

Enter the Tunnels of the Forsaken and be careful of occasional Wind Rider patrols. Head towards the objective marker and talk to Ghost of Althea. From there, head straight north, up the hill, and kill the bandits at the camp until you get a [[Elemental Keystone]]. Pick it up and bring it to the crystal gate in the north to open it, then enter the second level.

On the second level, head forward and take the left side wherever possible, left around the tree, left of the crystal, left around the rock, left around the cauldron and go under the overpass. Take left again after the glowing altar, and when you see dialogue from Duke Willgrove, head straight to find him. Talk to the Duke to retrieve the stolen supplies, making sure that you have inventory space to receive them.

To return the supplies to Althea on the first level of the dungeon, it is faster to map travel to Piken Square. Talk to Althea to return the stolen supplies, and again to accept the reward for the quest.

==Dialogue== 
===Initial dialogue=== 
;Kopp the Quick
:''"The places a fellow can lay his head without worry or threat are disappearing faster than I can cross the Breach. And they don't call me quick for nothing, mind you.''

:''A group of refugees set up an encampment in the Tunnels of the Forsaken. I traveled from [[Ascalon City]] with a shipment of supplies for them, but those tunnels are rife with bandits and monsters. There's a reason I wasn't called Kopp the Strong. '''Can you make sure these supplies are delivered safely to the refugees?''''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll make sure they get those supplies
| decline = I don't have time for this right now.
| ask = I do appreciate you taking those supplies the rest of the way to the '''encampment in the Tunnels of the Forsaken'''. Tight spaces don't lend themselves to those with the talent of swiftness. A fellow needs room to build up a good pace if he hopes to go the distance. That's what Kopp the Quick always says!
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Ghost of Althea
:''"Ah, the supplies shipment. On behalf of our humble settlement, I thank you. Unfortunately, you have caught us marred in trouble once more. It would seem that not only must we contend with the danger of [[Charr]] and ghoul, {{sic}} but the malice of man as well. Yes, one of our own has betrayed us."''

:''"One Duke Willgrove was displeased with the rationing of food we have resourced. He made off with enough supplies for three men, and fled deeper into the tunnels. '''Will you track down the duke and retrieve our stolen goods?''' Our existence here is precarious enough; we cannot stand the loss."''

:''"Oh, one other thing. '''Duke Willgrove made off with a Mesmer's staff as well.''' It's an heirloom of mine, in all honesty. Do be careful with it if you're able to retrieve it?"''
: '''⇒ I'll get those supplies back.'''

;Ghost of Althea
:''"'''Duke Willgrove headed deeper into the tunnels with our stolen supplies.''' I can't imagine what he hopes to achieve out there. In my own exploration, the tunnels seem to dead-end beyond the old barracks. Perhaps it's just that which the duke seeks: a dead end, if you'll excuse the expression. Perhaps he only means to satiate his gluttony once more before meeting [[Grenth]]."''
::{{no}} '''I'll track down the duke.'''


Approaching the bandits on level one:
:'''Bandit Bruiser:''' ''"I stubbed my toe on this dusty old crystal. Think it's worth anything?"''


Approaching Duke Willgrove on level two:
:'''Duke Willgrove:''' ''"Here's the staff you wanted, Varny. Now for your part of the bargain... You said you know a way out of this doomed kingdom?"''
:'''Orphan Varny:''' ''"Oh, you'll see soon enough. I've made a great discovery. Soon, I will lead all from the torments of this reality!"''
:'''Duke Willgrove:''' ''"Are you alright, boy? You've gone all funny in the eyes."''
:'''Orphan Varny:''' ''"I've seen the future, old man. And it's been hiding in the ancient past this whole time!"''

;Duke Willgrove
:''"You came after the supplies? Hey, no need to get aggressive now! It was all a misunderstanding. I was just, uh, a bit too hungry. Thinking with my stomach, as it were, heh. Anyways, I was just borrowing them! Here, take the supplies back, just leave me in peace!"''
::{{no}} '''Just hand it over, thief.'''


Talking to Duke Willgrove again without the Stolen Supply Shipment:
;Duke Willgrove
:''"What? That's everything, I swear!"''
::{{no}} '''It better be.'''


Talking to Duke Willgrove again with the Stolen Supply Shipment:
;Duke Willgrove
:''"I'm leaving. Don't say I never did anything for anybody!"''


;Ghost of Althea
:''"Are these the stolen supplies? excellent, they appear mostly intact. You have done these people a great kindness."''
::{{no}} '''Varny did make off with your staff...'''

===Reward dialogue===

;Ghost of Althea
:''"We all thank you for your help. Food is scarce, and down here survival is a balancing act along a blade's edge. At least the living can enjoy the taste of these meager rations. What is it, I wonder, that would satisfy the craving I feel inside myself?" ''

:''"Ah, forgive my musings. You said you saw Varny down there? Whatever could he want with my staff? Well, he will surely show back up at camp sooner or later. Varny is a troubled boy, undeserving of his destiny like many Ascalonians. I hope that he does not have to wait till the next world to find peace."''

==Notes==
* It is advisable to accept the following quest immediately, even if you do not intend to complete it yet, to prevent level 20 ghosts from populating the dungeon when you return.
* If you travel outside of the dungeon after recovering the stolen goods, the quest objectives will reset, but if you re-enter the dungeon they will return to where they should be, allowing you to complete the quest without redoing any steps.
* You can do this quest faster with a running build, since only some bandits on the first level have to be defeated, for the [[Elemental Keystone]]. Just make sure you bring something that can kill them (e.g. a party, a [[summoning stone]], or even combat skills alongside your running ones).
{{anomaly|The marker arrows above the Ghost of Althea and Duke Willgrove are not removed when you complete their objectives.}}
{{bug|The quest marker for Duke Willgrove will appear to point to the exit while on level two of the dungeon.}}
{{bug|When talking to Duke Willgrove, the chatbox displays "Quest Added" instead of "Quest Updated", and does so even if you have already completed the objective.}}
